563:t_000:20.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Constantly fussing over someone isn't the only way to be kind. Especially with $$ニコラ$$.」

563:t_000:23.en:
$$刹那$$
「Watching Captain $$アムロ$$ makes me realize how hard it is to understand one another.」

563:t_000:24.en:
$$シャア$$
「As long as you understand that.」

563:t_000:25.en:
$$シャア$$
「We need to understand one another, but understanding alone won't get us humans anywhere.」

563:t_000:26.en:
$$刹那$$
「Maybe I still don't really understand even what it means to understand one another...」

563:t_000:27.en:
$$グラハム$$
(You always strive to go further, young man...)

563:t_000:28.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Take it easy, my friend.」

563:t_000:29.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Just as $$刹那$$ follows his own path, you should follow yours.」

563:t_000:30.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Heh... Understanding one another is a wonderful thing.」

563:t_000:31.en:
$$チコ$$
「Looks like the old guys are getting all chummy...」

563:t_000:32.en:
$$マリ$$
「You're so twisted that you can't just say they're good friends, meow. Besides, isn't your twenties still too young to be called an old man or woman?」

563:t_000:34.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Is this any time to spout nonsense!? They're coming!」

563:t_001:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So those are the mysterious enemies that appeared near Jupiter.」

563:t_001:2.en:
$$アポロ$$
「What the hell are those? They look like lumps of metal...」

563:t_001:3.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Come to think of it, this is your first time seeing them.」

563:t_001:4.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「For convenience, we call them $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$.」

563:t_001:5.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「As you can see, they're what you might call metallic life-forms.」

563:t_001:6.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「And their most fearsome ability is that they can assimilate their targets into their own bodies, whether organic or inorganic.」

563:t_001:7.en:
$$シリウス$$
「Fusion through erosion... is that it?」

563:t_001:8.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「And we don't know how it works, but their erosion attacks damage the pilots, too.」

563:t_001:9.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「If their attacks cause a pilot to lose consciousness, all that's left is to fall prey to them.」

563:t_001:10.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「So if a pilot's mental state reaches a dangerous level during battle, I'll have them retreat.」

563:t_001:11.en:
$$ジン$$
「So even if the machine can still fight, the human inside goes down first and can't keep fighting.」

563:t_001:12.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Now we've even got enemies like that coming here.」

563:t_001:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「If they're metal, communication is impossible. In other words, they're $$バアル$$?」

563:t_001:16.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「You heard all that, everyone. Be very careful of the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$' erosion attacks.」

563:t_001:17.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Repelling those attacks will take hard work and guts! I'll show you I can do it!」

563:t_001:18.en:
$$赤木$$
「I'll follow $$ノリコ$$'s lead with fighting spirit, too!」

563:t_001:21.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Leave $$ニコラ$$ alone, $$タケル$$. Let's go.」

563:t_001:24.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Concentrate, $$ラルク$$. You'll die if you keep this up.」

563:t_001:27.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Big Sis... will die...」

563:t_001:28.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Big Sis... will die...」

563:t_001:29.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「...Someone I knew once suppressed her own feelings and fought for Earth.」

563:t_001:30.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Our worlds may be different, but if you're a $$バスターマシン$$ pilot, too, don't forget that feeling.」

563:t_001:34.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Let's go, $$ラルク$$. Please cover $$ガンバスター$$.」

563:t_001:36.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, commence your attack! Don't let a single $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ through!」

563:t_002:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Are they withdrawing because they've decided they can't win... or because their reconnaissance mission is over...?」

563:t_002:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Either way, we'll need to be careful.」

563:t_003:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Unlike the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s or $$宇宙怪獣$$, those $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ are a real pain to fight.」

563:t_003:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「Yes. If it were a battle of strength against strength, we'd just meet them head-on, but those erosion attacks...」

563:t_003:4.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「About those $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$... It seems they act by detecting $$脳量子波$$.」

563:t_003:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What we call $$サイコ・ウェーブ|lc$$ in our world?」

563:t_003:7.en:
$$シン$$
「Does that mean they're targeting $$イノベイター$$s like $$刹那$$ and $$ニュータイプ$$s like $$カミーユ$$?」

563:t_003:8.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「It's not certain yet, but there are signs of that.」

563:t_003:10.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Leaving them unchecked will lead to trouble.」

563:t_003:11.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Are you so scared of being targeted yourselves?」

563:t_003:13.en:
$$シャア$$
「Stop, $$ハマーン$$. Leave him alone in his current state.」

563:t_003:14.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Neither $$サイコ・ウェーブ|lc$$ nor $$脳量子波$$ are special powers exclusive to $$ニュータイプ$$s or $$イノベイター$$s. Everyone has them, though they're weak.」

563:t_003:15.en:
$$シャア$$
「And since the $$大時空震動$$, people's awakening as $$ニュータイプ$$s has been progressing rapidly.」

563:t_003:17.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Director $$ナナイ$$ said so, too. Apparently, that trend occurs among both $$アースノイド$$s and $$スペースノイド$$s.」

563:t_003:18.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「The same phenomenon applies to becoming an $$イノベイター$$ in $$ＡＤＷ$$. There are already people besides $$刹那$$ whose awakening is progressing...」

563:t_003:19.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「The number of potential awakened individuals is increasing beyond any level we can track.」

563:t_003:20.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Is all of humanity beginning to evolve...?」

563:t_003:23.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Talk later. Something else is coming...!」

uncertain: 563:t_001:29/32: Noriko Big Sis refers to Kazumi; pronoun restored from adjacent conversation.
